g.text: Prompt User to Choose Another Flight
UML 2.5 ACTIVITY DIAGRAM NOTATION LEGEND & CONCURRENCY PROTOCOLS
Activity Final Node: Complete end of activity flow.
Action State: Unit of executable computation.
Fork / Join Bar: Concurrent execution & synchronization.
Flow Final Node: Terminates single alternative branch.
• Seat Inventory Race Condition Prevention: Row-level lock on MySQL flights row.
• Saga Orchestration: Feign client rollback increments seats if payment fails.
• Idempotent Web Check-In: Unique boarding_pass_number constraint prevents double-booking.
• Zero Distributed Locks: Synchronous Feign + Circuit Breaker fallback timeouts.
